name: deriv_assessment_batch_file_arrival
description: File-arrival driven batch pipeline: Bronze batch JSON -> Silver -> Gold -> reconciliation. Fires when new files land in the batch landing volume. The streaming Bronze tables it reads are maintained independently by the continuous job in create_job_streaming.json.

tasks.description: Batch JSON -> Bronze. Advances bronze_load_master only after the write commits, then moves consumed files to /Volumes/workspace/deriv_assement/data/archive/{table}/{load_ts}/. The archive is outside the trigger's watched path, so draining the landing folder cannot re-trigger this job.

Bronze -> Silver for the vendor deposit feed: declared alias map, DQ gate, dedupe on deposit_id, idempotent MERGE, quarantine release. Reads batch Bronze at the bronze_load_master watermark and streaming Bronze in full.
CDC -> dim_client SCD2 applied in LSN order with soft deletes. Guarded by its own lsn watermark in cdc_apply_log, so it is safe to run more often than CDC files actually arrive.
Silver -> Gold star schema: conformed dimensions, inferred late-arriving members, fact tables at declared grain.

Two-tier vendor-to-warehouse reconciliation and control totals. Last in the chain so it reconciles a fully built warehouse. No retries: a retry would append a second run_id's evidence for one logical run.
